_doc: Cross-season player identity registry — the source of truth the migration generator consumes. people: slug -> person record. kind 'kid' people carry family_member (matched against family_members.name where role='kid') so the generated migration resolves user_id via subquery and stays portable across prod/local. aliases: gc_player_id -> slug, the team-scoped GameChanger player id mapped to a person. The importer proposes new aliases on each capture; Andrew confirms; accepted entries land here.
